description: This file contains unit tests for the EnforcerRetriever class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement package. It uses Mockito and JUnit to verify the behavior of cache lookups and exception handling in the retrieval logic.

classes.name: EnforcerRetrieverTest

methods.description: Initializes the EnforcerRetriever instance before each test.
